themes: Indonesian microfinance and rural lenders are outperforming on domestic credit demand, a structural tailwind from rising consumption and SME formalization.
US financial weakness is a decoupling opportunity—local banks with strong NIMs and low dollar exposure will keep re-rating as IDR stability holds.
Consolidation in the insurance sector (TUGU, PEGE) is driving revaluation, with M&A premiums and capital optimization as durable value drivers.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian financials on idiosyncratic strength—STAR (+22%) and XCIS (+10%) signal local credit/microfinance momentum, while US drag is transient. Favor AHAP, ASMI, and DNAR for continued upside; avoid broad beta, rotate into niche lenders with earnings catalysts.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's domestic coal demand and export pricing to China/India remain structurally firm, underpinning sustained margins for large-cap producers like BYAN and ADMR despite global volatility.
Nickel's downstream smelting push and EV battery supply chain integration give INCO and TINS a durable growth premium, insulated from short-term commodity swings.
Regulatory stability under the new government's energy self-sufficiency agenda supports upstream investment, favoring integrated miners over pure traders like ENRG and ALKA.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian coal and nickel names on the back of a strong ID bid, but lock in gains into strength—BYAN's +20% and ENRG's +32% are momentum spikes, not new fundamentals. Favor ADMR and INCO for volume-backed upside; trim TINS and ALKA as they approach resistance. Watch US energy weakness as a drag, but local demand and export pricing keep the sector constructive for a 2-4 week hold.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech

US climate-tech underperformance reflects policy uncertainty and high rates, but Indonesian names benefit from sovereign green funding and local currency stability, creating a persistent valuation gap
sectors.ai: Buy dips in Indonesia-listed renewables names, especially VKTR and TOBA, as local momentum (+0.32%) diverges from US weakness (-1.15%)—a signal of domestic policy-driven demand. Rotate out of US-exposed climate tech into IDX green leaders ahead of Q3 earnings, targeting PGEO and ARKO for 10-15% upside.

US-linked infrastructure plays face headwinds from higher-for-longer rates, making local-currency, government-backed projects the preferred risk-adjusted exposure.

Rotate out of US-exposed names like PACK and ASLI, which lag on Fed uncertainty. Favor LINK for digital infrastructure upside, and accumulate EXCL on telecom tower re-rating.

sectors.name: Healthcare
themes: Indonesia's healthcare demand is structurally driven by a young, expanding middle class and rising chronic disease prevalence, insulating domestic players from global rate cycles.

Government push for universal health coverage (JKN) and local manufacturing incentives (e.g., import substitution for medical devices) creates durable tailwinds for domestic producers and distributors
US healthcare names (CVS, CNC) face margin compression from pharmacy benefit manager reforms and Medicaid redeterminations, making them structurally less attractive than ID-focused operators.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian healthcare names with domestic revenue exposure, as the sector's +0.34% ID outperformance versus US -0.27% confirms local resilience. SRAJ (+15.38%) and PEHA (+13.64%) signal momentum in pharma distribution and hospital supplies; add on pullbacks, but avoid US-linked laggards. Position for Q3 earnings catalysts, prioritizing firms with pricing power and government procurement ties.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's port and toll-road infrastructure upgrades are structurally lowering logistics costs, benefiting domestic operators like TAXI and HATM over foreign peers.
Cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics demand is rising with the expansion of Indonesia's pharmaceutical and FMCG sectors, underpinning ASSA's durable growth.
Air cargo capacity constraints and e-commerce cross-border flows are creating recurring rate tailwinds for GIAA and SHIP, though these are more volatile than land-based logistics.
sectors.ai: Buy TAXI and HATM on continued domestic logistics consolidation and port efficiency gains; GIAA upside is freight-rate driven but air cargo exposure is cyclical, so take partial profits. Maintain overweight on ASSA for resilient cold-chain demand. Trim US-linked names (AMKBY, CBRE) as ID outperformance persists.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's pending crypto tax harmonization and exchange licensing under Bappebti is a structural catalyst for compliant, utility-driven tokens over speculative ones.
Global RWA tokenization (ONDO, RAIN) is compounding as institutional treasuries and Indonesian corporates seek on-chain yield alternatives to fiat deposits.
Liquid staking and restaking narratives (ETHFI, MORPHO) are gaining durable traction as DeFi leverage demand rises, independent of Bitcoin's price direction.
sectors.ai: Rotate into high-beta liquid alts (BTW, MORPHO, ETHFI) for near-term momentum, but keep core longs in yield-bearing RWA plays (ONDO, RAIN) as the durable bid. Trim ZEC/WLD into strength; the aggregate signal is normal, not euphoric, so add on dips rather than chase. Indonesia's regulatory clarity on digital assets remains a tailwind for compliant exchanges, favoring tokens with real utility over memetic names.
